title: Märchen Crown Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: This year's 50th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine announced on Thursday Aka Akasaka , Aoi Kujira , and Ajichika 's Märchen Crown manga will end in the next issue on November 19. The manga debuted in Young Jump in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: 'Skip to Loafer 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, First Promo
content: • The official website for the Skip to Loafer ( Skip and Loafer ) television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, new key visual, and the first promotional video for the Season 2 on Monday. The second season adapting Misaki Takamatsu 's coming-of-age manga will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Skip & Loafer Anime's 2nd Season Reveals More Cast in 1st Promo Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Misaki Takamatsu 's Skip and Loafer ( Skip to Loafer ) manga revealed the first promotional video and more cast on Monday for the anime's second season .
author: ANN

title: 'Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu' Reveals Main Staff, Winter 2027 Premiere
content: The official website of the Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu television anime revealed the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series, based on the character project designed and produced by Sanrio for the Touken Ranbu Online game, will premiere on January 6 at 9:54 p.m. on Tokyo MX.

title: Black Witch Mirror Manga to End in 4th Volume
content: Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Yonan Togawa 's Black Witch Mirror ( Kokufu Kyōdan ) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 15, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s Godzilla Anime Hit Really Needs a Season 2
content: Godzilla has been on the rise in popularity over several decades, rampaging its way to new heights across countless media, including Hollywood and Japanese movies, TV shows, anime series , video games, comics, and more.

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Re:Zero Season 5
content: One of the biggest Isekai franchises now streaming with Crunchyroll has now confirmed it’s coming back for Season 5 in the near future. The anime adaptation for Tappei Nagatsuki and Shinichirou Otsuka has been on an incredible run for the past decade as it now celebrates its 10th anniversary.

title: Witch Watch Season 2 Premieres 2027
content: Witch Watch Season 2 is set to premiere in 2027. A teaser visual featuring the main character Nico Wakatsuki was also released. The second season was previously announced immediately after the first season’s finale, which premiered on October 5, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: SPITZ Band's Drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama Seriously Injured in Traffic Accident
content: The official website for Japanese rock band SPITZ announced on Sunday that its drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama was rushed to the hospital after sustaining serious injuries across his entire body in a traffic accident.
author: ANN
